newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel, Dassault in joint bid for Thomson-CSF.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel, Dassault in joint bid for Thomson-CSF.

text.p: French conglomerate Alcatel Alsthom and Dassault Industries said on Wednesday they would launch a joint bid for defence electronics group Thomson-CSF.
The two companies said in a joint statement that the bid envisaged the possibility of major cooperation between state-owned aircraft and defence company Aerospatiale and Thomson-CSF.
The French government said on Tuesday it was ready to relaunch the privatisation of Thomson-CSF, which it was forced to suspend last year.
Earlier on Wednesday, the government announced the procedure for the privatisation, including minimum financial terms and conditions.

Lagardere Groupe, which was the government's choice last November as the buyer of Thomson, said earlier on Wednesday it would take account of Aerospatiale's non-consumer electronics and defence activities in its own bid for Thomson-CSF.
The government has said it hopes to choose a successful candidate for the takeover of Thomson-CSF by June 30.
